title.description: Exact or bibliographically useful source title; may remain in its original language.

organizationOrAuthor.description: Official source/author metadata; may remain in its original language.

sourceType.description: Stable code; Persian label is resolved through config/fa-taxonomy.json.

locator.description: Exact unit, lesson, page, section or item locator; may remain in the source language when useful for traceability.

publishedOrUpdatedAt.description: Publication/revision date or year when known. This is evidence, not a universal age cutoff.

modernityStatus.description: Stable code; Persian label is resolved through config/fa-taxonomy.json. Learner-facing content may rely only on contemporary_verified or maintained_current sources.

currencyEvidence.description: Assistant-authored explanation of source currency/modernity. It must be written in Persian.

attributionText.description: Exact attribution/bibliographic text may remain in its official form.

reuseStatus.description: Stable code; Persian label is resolved through config/fa-taxonomy.json.

notes.description: Assistant-authored source note; must be Persian.
